subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this issue stay distinct for Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` pressure, or should maintainers fold it into the broader Telegram ambiguous-send/guarded-lane recovery work?
rationale: Source evidence shows a shared unknown-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview/final-delivery trigger and Control UI history latency that the broader open Telegram lane issue and candidate PR do not fully cover.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery and decide whether Control UI history refresh needs backpressure or debouncing.

options.title: Fold Into Telegram Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track remaining recovery work through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 plus its candidate PRs.

options.title: Split History Pressure Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate Control UI/Gateway item if `chat.history` pressure is confirmed independently.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove `/reasoning stream` preview/final delivery and decide whether Control UI history refresh needs backpressure or debouncing.

likelyOwner.reason: The central maintainer choice is in the outbound recovery semantics recently changed by their merged recovery work.
